item.title: EplayerX 1.2.26
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 改善首页首次加载时骨架屏与背景封面的衔接，减少空白和内容跳动。 - 优化首页、媒体库、详情页和社区的横向列表布局、边距及翻页按钮显示。 - 调整资源选择面板的按钮样式，让操作界面更简洁。 - 优化预告片画质增强，并减少非 4K 视频的软件解码提示。 - 改善通过 Infuse 播放时的进度恢复与播放状态同步。 - 在「关于」中加入 Discord 社区反馈入口。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Improved the transition from loading placeholders to Home artwork, reducing blank areas and content jumps. - Refined horizontal list layouts, spacing, and paging controls across Home, libraries, detail pages, and Community. - Simplified button styling in the resource selection panel. - Improved trailer video enhancement and reduced software decoding notices for videos below 4K. - Improved playback resume and state synchronization when using Infuse. - Added a Discord community feedback link in About.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
